ssio_sdr_in.summary: Source-synchronous SDR input: buffers the forwarded clock via target-specific primitives and captures input data in an IOB register on that clock.

blocks.name: Clock buffering
blocks.description: Target-specific buffering of input_clk into clk_io and output_clk

anchors.name: clk_int
anchors.why: Buffered internal copy of input_clk feeding output clock

blocks.name: Input capture register
blocks.description: Registers input_d on clk_io into output_q

anchors.name: output_q_reg
anchors.why: IOB capture register sampling input_d every clk_io edge

anchors.name: input_d
anchors.why: Source-synchronous input data captured by output_q_reg

anchors.name: output_q
anchors.why: Registered data output driven from output_q_reg

oddr.summary: Portable DDR output register: vendor ODDR primitives for Xilinx/Altera, otherwise a generic model that drives q from d1 on rising edge and registered d2 on falling edge.

blocks.name: generic_ddr_output
blocks.description: Generic two-edge register model multiplexing d1 and d2 onto q.

anchors.name: genblk1.q_reg
anchors.why: Output flop updated on both clock edges, alternately with d1 and d_reg_2.

anchors.name: genblk1.d_reg_2
anchors.why: Captures d2 at posedge to present on negedge output.

anchors.name: genblk1.d_reg_1
anchors.why: Registered d1 copy; unused (no fanout) in generic path.

blocks.name: ddr_ports
blocks.description: Two single-rate inputs combined into one DDR output.

anchors.name: d1
anchors.why: Rising-edge data input sampled into q_reg on posedge clk.

anchors.name: d2
anchors.why: Falling-edge data input, registered into d_reg_2 first.

anchors.name: q
anchors.why: Double-data-rate output driven by q_reg.

ssio_sdr_out.summary: Source-synchronous SDR output: an IOB register retimes input data while an ODDR instance driven with constant 0/1 forwards an inverted-phase output clock.

blocks.name: Data output register
blocks.description: IOB flip-flop retiming input data to the output pins

anchors.name: input_d
anchors.why: Parallel data captured into the IOB output register each clock

anchors.name: output_q_reg
anchors.why: IOB register retiming input_d onto output pins every cycle

anchors.name: output_q
anchors.why: Registered SDR data output driven from output_q_reg

blocks.name: Clock forwarding
blocks.description: ODDR with d1=0, d2=1 producing forwarded output clock

anchors.name: output_clk
anchors.why: Forwarded clock generated by ODDR toggling constant 0/1 inputs

anchors.name: phy_gmii_rxd
anchors.why: Receive data byte from PHY captured by the SDR input cell

anchors.name: mac_gmii_rxd
anchors.why: Registered receive data forwarded to the MAC

anchors.name: mac_gmii_rx_dv
anchors.why: Receive data valid to MAC, captured alongside rxd

blocks.name: TX SDR output
blocks.description: Retimes MAC transmit bus and forwards clock to the PHY

anchors.name: mac_gmii_txd
anchors.why: Transmit data byte from MAC into the SDR output cell

anchors.name: phy_gmii_txd
anchors.why: Retimed transmit data driven to the PHY

anchors.name: phy_gmii_tx_en
anchors.why: Transmit enable to PHY qualifying txd

blocks.name: TX clock select

anchors.why: Selects MII PHY tx clock or system clk as MAC transmit clock

blocks.name: Reset synchronizers
blocks.description: Shift-register reset synchronizers for TX and RX clock domains

anchors.name: rx_rst_reg

anchors.why: Synchronized TX-domain reset output from tx_rst_reg

anchors.name: mac_gmii_rx_rst
anchors.why: Synchronized RX-domain reset output from rx_rst_reg

axis_gmii_rx.summary: GMII/MII-to-AXI-Stream receiver: a five-stage byte delay line (with MII nibble assembly) feeds a 3-state FSM that strips preamble and checks CRC32 FCS via an LFSR.

blocks.name: Receive FSM
blocks.description: Detects SFD, forwards payload, checks FCS and errors

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/PAYLOAD/WAIT_LAST receive FSM driving AXI output and CRC control

anchors.name: reset_crc

anchors.name: update_crc
anchors.why: Advances CRC during PAYLOAD

anchors.name: cfg_rx_enable
anchors.why: Enables acceptance of new frames in IDLE

blocks.name: Input delay line

anchors.name: gmii_rxd

anchors.name: gmii_rx_dv

anchors.name: gmii_rx_er

anchors.name: gmii_rxd_d4

anchors.name: gmii_rx_dv_d4

anchors.name: gmii_rx_er_d4

anchors.name: in_frame

anchors.name: clk_enable

anchors.name: mii_select

anchors.name: crc_next

anchors.name: gmii_txd_next

eth_mac_1g.summary: 1G Ethernet MAC top that wires an AXI-Stream-to-GMII transmitter and a GMII-to-AXI-Stream receiver in separate clock domains; MAC control/pause logic is parameter-disabled, so AXIS ports pass straight through.

blocks.name: Transmit path
blocks.description: axis_gmii_tx converts transmit AXI-Stream into GMII bytes with preamble, FCS and IFG.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Transmit AXI-Stream payload byte forwarded to the GMII transmitter.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Transmit AXI-Stream valid feeding the transmitter input handshake.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tready
anchors.why: Transmit AXI-Stream ready, copied from the GMII transmitter's s_axis_tready.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker of the transmit stream.

anchors.name: gmii_txd
anchors.why: GMII transmit data byte produced by the transmitter instance.

anchors.name: gmii_tx_en
anchors.why: GMII transmit enable marking valid transmitted bytes.

anchors.name: cfg_ifg
anchors.why: Configured inter-frame gap length used by the transmitter.

anchors.name: cfg_tx_enable
anchors.why: Enables the transmit path in the GMII transmitter.

anchors.name: tx_mii_select
anchors.why: Selects MII nibble mode versus GMII byte mode for transmit.

anchors.name: tx_clk_enable
anchors.why: Clock enable qualifying transmitter cycles (for MII/lower rates).

anchors.name: tx_error_underflow
anchors.why: Transmitter reports AXIS underflow during a frame.

anchors.name: tx_start_packet
anchors.why: Pulse indicating transmitter started a new packet.

blocks.name: Receive path
blocks.description: axis_gmii_rx strips preamble, checks FCS and emits receive AXI-Stream.

anchors.name: gmii_rxd
anchors.why: GMII receive data byte entering the receiver instance.

anchors.name: gmii_rx_dv
anchors.why: GMII receive data valid framing incoming bytes.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Received AXI-Stream payload byte from the GMII receiver.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Received stream valid; no ready, receiver pushes data each cycle.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Receive sideband user bits (bad-frame flag, optional timestamp).

anchors.name: cfg_rx_enable
anchors.why: Enables the receive path in the GMII receiver.

anchors.name: rx_mii_select
anchors.why: Selects MII nibble mode versus GMII byte mode for receive.

anchors.name: rx_clk_enable
anchors.why: Clock enable qualifying receiver cycles.

anchors.name: rx_error_bad_fcs
anchors.why: Receiver reports frame with failing CRC32 FCS.

anchors.name: rx_error_bad_frame
anchors.why: Receiver reports malformed or errored frame.

anchors.name: rx_start_packet
anchors.why: Pulse indicating receiver started a new packet.

blocks.name: Disabled MAC control

eth_mac_1g_gmii.summary: GMII Ethernet MAC wrapper that wires a GMII PHY interface to a 1G MAC core and auto-detects link speed by counting a prescaled rx_clk against gtx_clk, driving MII/GMII select through synchronizers.

blocks.name: phy_interface
blocks.description: GMII PHY I/O cells converting PHY pins to internal MAC GMII signals.

anchors.name: gmii_rxd
anchors.why: GMII receive data from PHY into PHY interface.

anchors.name: gmii_txd
anchors.why: GMII transmit data to PHY from PHY interface.

anchors.name: mac_gmii_rxd
anchors.why: Internal registered GMII rx data between PHY interface and MAC.

anchors.name: mac_gmii_txd
anchors.why: Internal GMII tx data from MAC to PHY interface.

blocks.name: mac_core

anchors.name: tx_axis_tdata

anchors.name: tx_axis_tvalid

anchors.name: rx_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: AXI-Stream receive valid from MAC core.

blocks.description: Counts prescaled rx_clk vs gtx_clk to set speed and MII select.

anchors.name: rx_speed_count_2

anchors.name: speed_reg

anchors.name: mii_select_reg
